## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: grep -rln 'design-notes' plugins/dso/ | grep -v migrate-design-notes-to-design-md returns no matches
- dd-2: All consumers updated to read repo-root DESIGN.md instead, with fallback for unmigrated projects

## Implementation
Retarget every design-notes.md reference in plugins/dso/ to DESIGN.md:
- agents: ui-designer.md, gov-copy-writer.md
- skills: brainstorm, design-review, visual-evaluator, ui-discover, roadmap, sprint, onboarding, preplanning
- prompts: ui-designer-dispatch-protocol.md, scale-inference.md
- reviewers: component-reuse.md, north-star-alignment.md, visual-design.md, form-input-design.md, tech-compliance.md, maintainability.md
- scripts: check-onboarding.sh (update path + add fallback)
- config: update design.design_notes_path default in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, dso-config.example.conf, workflow-config-schema.json

For executable scripts (check-onboarding.sh): use read-config.sh design.design_notes_path for path resolution.
For instruction .md files: direct text replacement to DESIGN.md with inline fallback note.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] No residual design-notes references — Verify: test $(grep -rln 'design-notes' plugins/dso/ | grep -v migrate-design-notes-to-design-md | grep -v test | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -eq 0
- [ ] Config default updated — Verify: grep -q 'DESIGN.md' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
